overview: The School Committee voted to appoint Interim Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Galusi as the permanent superintendent, citing her high performance and the need for leadership continuity. The committee also approved the foundational educational plan for the Medford High School building project.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine bills, payrolls, capital purchases, grants, and field trips, as well as a $1,000 donation to the orchestra program and meeting minutes from January 26, 2026.

items.title: Mustang Moments: Best Buddies and Project 351
items.summary: Students and advisors presented updates on the Medford High School Best Buddies program's inclusion efforts and the Project 351 ambassadors' participation in statewide service initiatives.

items.title: Medford High School Building Project Educational Plan
items.summary: Approved the proposed educational plan for the high school building project, which serves as the guiding document for the MSBA process. The committee granted the superintendent authority to make non-substantive changes as needed prior to the submission deadline.

items.title: Appointment of Permanent Superintendent
items.summary: The committee voted to appoint Dr. Suzanne Galusi as the permanent superintendent pending successful contract negotiations, opting to forgo an external search in favor of district stability. Members highlighted her performance during her year as interim, her role in major ongoing projects, and consistent support from staff and the community.

subject: Appointment of Permanent Superintendent
